Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Vikram Singh,Sudhir Kumar Rai Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.325 of 2024 under sections 376, 323, 504 IPC,
P.S Kotwali, District Unnao.

3. In terms of the FIR, the informant aged about 30 years stated that she was working as fourth class employee and the applicant was also frequently visiting the place where the victim was working and disclosed that she was Hindu by religion and thereafter by enticing her promise to marry her.
It was also stated that for the last seven years, the victim and the applicant were having relations.
It was also stated that the victim was being pressurized to convert into Islam and performed marriage.

entities.text: Nihal Ahmad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the victim is aged about 30 years and as per own admission, the relationship in between the applicant and the victim continued over a span of seven years and the fact that the applicant has not been prosecuted under the illegal conversion act, a case for bail is made more so when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 25.05.2024.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Nihal Ahmad be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 VNP/-
